description:
This folder documents eight new air handling unit (AHU) fault datasets, covering various building configurations, control strategies, seasons, and injected faults.

Additionally, a comparative study of publicly-available datasets is conducted to identify suitable dataset pairs and their corresponding faults, providing researchers with resources for evaluating their transfer learning (TL) algorithms. Notably, the results of this section can also be used for other inter-class studies, such as cross-building fault-symptoms comparisons, but TL remains the primary use case of this work.
